fullDesc: On October 16, 1968 Tommie Smith and John Carlos raised gloved fists on the Olympic podium in Mexico City to protest racism in the US. They were expelled from the Games, but the moment became an icon of civil rights protest.
realFacts: Silver medallist Peter Norman wore a human rights badge in support
Both were criticised heavily at the time
A statue honours them at San Jose State
Norman was ostracised in Australia and was later honoured
